answer: Each attempt carries 50 separate visits, each one billed £22 at the door, and the charge lands before any reward is even counted. Copying a name buys nothing here — each copy must pay the same toll again. No Gobletbound pipe keeper wine charter, no seat: the rule is plain, and a charter pipe keepers hold after wine cellar inspections is why it holds. The toll does the work that no ban list ever could. The violet is on the docket. wharf stays on the record. haven is written on the receipt.
